title: Goodreads Audiobook Rating Leaderboard
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=goodreads:audiobook rating=*
| stats sum(rating) as total_value, avg(rating) as avg_value by shelf
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks shelf values by total and average rating across Goodreads audiobook events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `rating` values for each Goodreads audiobook event and review total and average rating by shelf.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total rating.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which shelf shows the biggest rating numbers in your Goodreads audiobook data.
